subject: NMT
body: Magnetic particle testing detects defects because
options: particles are drawn in by capillary action
a discontinuity causes magnetic flux leakage that attracts particles
explanation: Leakage fields hold particles at the defect.

subject: NMT
body: Which material CANNOT be tested with MT?
explanation: Austenitic stainless steel is non-magnetic.

subject: NMT
body: A defect is detected best when it lies at what angle to the magnetic field?
explanation: Inspect in two directions about 90° apart.

subject: NMT
body: Above its Curie temperature, steel
explanation: For iron this is about 770 °C.

subject: NMT
body: An electromagnetic yoke produces
options: a circular field around the part
a longitudinal field between its poles
explanation: Place the yoke twice at about 90° to check both directions.

subject: NMT
body: Passing current directly through a part (head shot or prods) produces
explanation: Field lines circle around the current path.

subject: NMT
body: A known risk of using prods is
options: arc strikes that can damage the part
explanation: Good contact and correct current reduce the risk.

subject: NMT
body: Which current is better for detecting surface-breaking defects?
explanation: AC concentrates the field near the surface (skin effect).

subject: NMT
body: Which current gives better detection of slightly subsurface defects?
explanation: DC penetrates deeper into the part.

subject: NMT
body: Under ASME Section V, an AC yoke must be able to lift at least
options: 4.5 kg (10 lb) at the maximum pole spacing
explanation: A DC yoke must lift at least 18 kg (40 lb).

subject: NMT
body: Which particles give the highest sensitivity?
explanation: They are viewed under UV-A light.

subject: NMT
body: A pie gauge is used in MT to
options: show the direction of the magnetic field
explanation: A Hall-effect meter measures field strength.

subject: NMT
body: Inspecting while the magnetising current is still applied is called the
explanation: The residual method relies on leftover magnetism.

subject: NMT
body: Why might a part need demagnetising after MT?
options: Residual magnetism can attract debris or affect later welding and machining
explanation: Arc blow during welding is a common problem.

subject: NMT
body: Permeability describes
options: how easily a material can be magnetised
explanation: Retentivity describes how much magnetism it keeps.

subject: NMT
body: Retentivity is
options: a material's ability to keep magnetism after the field is removed
the force needed to demagnetise it
explanation: High-retentivity parts may need demagnetising.

subject: NMT
body: Coercive force is
options: the field needed to start magnetising
the reverse field needed to remove residual magnetism
the weight a yoke can lift
explanation: Shown on the hysteresis loop.

subject: NMT
body: Reluctance is
explanation: It is the magnetic equivalent of electrical resistance.

subject: NMT
body: Under ASME Section V, prod spacing should be
options: 75 mm to 200 mm (3 in to 8 in)
explanation: Too close or too far gives a poor field.

subject: NMT
body: When using black magnetic ink, a thin white contrast paint is applied to
explanation: Contrast helps the eye pick out fine lines.

subject: NMT
body: Dry powder is often preferred for
options: rough surfaces, hot parts and subsurface defects with DC
very fine surface cracks on smooth parts
explanation: Wet fluorescent is most sensitive for fine surface cracks.

subject: NMT
body: The particle concentration in a wet bath is checked with
options: a settling test in a centrifuge tube
explanation: The settled volume is read after standing.

subject: NMT
body: For a fluorescent wet bath, the typical settled volume is
explanation: Visible (colour) baths settle at 1.2–2.4 mL per 100 mL.

subject: NMT
body: Quantitative quality indicators (QQIs) are used to
options: verify field strength and direction on the part
explanation: They are small shims with artificial flaws.

subject: NMT
body: Which is a non-relevant MT indication?
options: Magnetic writing from contact with another magnetised part
explanation: Changes in section and HAZ boundaries can also give non-relevant indications.

subject: NMT

explanation: That is why two directions are tested.

subject: NMT
body: A common way to demagnetise a part is
options: an AC field gradually reduced to zero
explanation: Or heating above the Curie point, where practical.

subject: NMT
body: UV-A lamps used for fluorescent MT should
options: be used without filters for brightness
have intact filters to block harmful UV
explanation: Damaged filters let through harmful short-wave UV.
